headline: UK Unveils $800 Million AI Security Plan as Developers Restrict Model Exploits
summary: The UK launched an $800 million AI security funding plan while Chinese AI firm Moonshot restricted hacking capabilities in its new Kimi model in response to rising concerns over automated cyberattacks.
why: Governments and frontier AI labs are increasing defensive spending as AI-assisted cyber threats become an escalating operational and sovereign risk.

impacts.name: Cybersecurity
impacts.why: New state funding and heightened corporate security needs expand revenue opportunities for cybersecurity firms.
